Later independently authorized proof and opportunity reach outbox beyond denied prefix. All-denied finite wrap writes no proof/outbox/cursor and leaves consent/evidence unchanged. findings.B18-REV09-03: Local emulator verifies mutable SRS mirror with reciprocal fresh immutable receipt/current base and increasing resulting revision, matching payload word/entity identity, owner isolation and exact fields. Revision1 create/revision2 and3 updates pass; stale/gap bases, nonadvance, replay writes, missing receipts, cross-owner, tombstone, extra fields and identity mismatch fail. Coalesced result revision jumps remain compatible with client monotonic revision semantics; no rules deployment.
